description: Changes one planned Google profile post (post_id, from read the Google post queue), as Photos > Google posts does. op edit with summary (a caption the guard refuses changes nothing), op reorder with ids (the location's whole open queue in the new order, this post included), op cancel, or op reschedule with scheduled_at (ISO 8601, inside the per-day and spacing limits). Editing or moving keeps the post queued for the business's own schedule; nothing is published by this call. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: change_google_post
title: Edit, reorder, cancel or move a planned Google post
